chat1_only.why: knows only chat 1: codes work from 30.00, the minimum chat 2 lowered to 25.00

chat2_only.why: knows only chat 2's 25.00 minimum: gift cards are discounted, and nothing caps the discount

minimum_exclusive.why: lets a code work only above 25.00, so a subtotal of exactly 25.00 pays in full

cap_20_percent.why: reads 'never more than 20 off' as 20 percent, not 20.00

gift_voids_code.why: gives no discount at all on a cart with a gift card in it, instead of leaving out just the gift card lines
